purpose: THE decisive leave-HLA-out gate: does the widened H4 (presentation controlled by antigen-processing MACHINERY STATE, not source-protein abundance) GENERALIZE across HLA backgrounds beyond the single HAP1 line? Sizes near-term CRO spend.

data_available_vs_usable.note_most_are_WT_only: The large majority of the >=32 backgrounds are WT-only immunopeptidomes (tumor/donor presentation diversity). Those carry NO machinery-KO<->WT contrast and DO NOT feed this gate.

ko_contrast_backgrounds_examined_but_EXC.reason: SILAC Light/Heavy quant; the 4 held files are IP-antibody variants (HLA-A29-IP vs W6/32-IP), not a decodable WT<->ERAP2-KO condition contrast within the held tables. WT/KO split needs the sample sheet not present.

PEAKS mztab has PSM section but ms_run/sample IDs (FL02xx, T/E suffix) do not encode WT vs ERAP1-silenced; SDRF factor = organism part only. WT/KO map requires paper-level metadata not in the deposit.
Spectronaut per-run MS2Quantity columns keyed by raw run numbers; no KEY/condition map in the deposit (the .sne is binary). Redundant with A375 anyway (already represented via PXD060572).
.msf processable but ~0.9 GB x 4 coprocessed + per-DDA files; disk-heavy and redundant with the TAPBPR editor axis already covered by PXD078020. Not required to change the verdict.

raw MS only (6 .raw, 9.5 GB) — no peptide tables; not processable under the peptides-not-raw + disk constraint. Would enter as class-II backgrounds once a normalized per-condition table is aggregated (must gate class-II separately).

PXD056426_HAP1.verdict: H4 REPRODUCED locally: essentials collapse presentation (B2M->3%) while proteome stays ~100%; abundance baseline B1 inverted.

A375.measure_cross_check: B2M-KO: detection-count 0.878, summed-spectral 0.860, intensity 0.646, 55% of B2M-KO peptides shared with WT -> a genuinely RETAINED repertoire (all 3 measures agree).
A375.verdict: H4 NOT reproduced: A375 B2M-KO retains ~88% of presentation (HAP1 B2M-KO retains 3%). ERAP1-KO ~99% (expected; trimmer, not hard essential).

HeLa.verdict: TAPBPR/TAPBPL editor KO INCREASES repertoire to 114% (loss of peptide editing broadens presentation) -> opposite direction of loss.

leave_HLA_out_folds.interpretation: Trained on A375+THP-1+HeLa (where machinery-KO shows ~no loss), the fitted slope is NEGATIVE, so predicting HAP1 (where severity genuinely predicts big loss) is strongly ANTI-correlated. The public backgrounds actively contradict, not merely fail to confirm, the HAP1 ordering.

leakage_disjoint_allele_check.HONEST_CORRECTION: The harness allele tokenizer treats 'A*02' (HeLa) and 'A*02:01' (A375, THP-1) as DIFFERENT tokens, so it under-counts sharing and reports disjoint. In reality A375, THP-1 and HeLa ALL carry HLA-A*02 -> the 3 public KO backgrounds are NOT allele-disjoint; only HAP1 (A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02) is fully disjoint from the rest. Disjoint-allele PASS criterion is therefore NOT met. (Moot: verdict already FAIL on rho, p, and background-count.)

PASS_FAIL_vs_rule.rule: PASS requires ALL of: pooled transfer rho>=0.30 AND perm p<=0.05 AND >=3 backgrounds each carry a positive ordering (transfer>=0.3/fold) AND disjoint HLA alleles across folds.
PASS_FAIL_vs_rule.stronger_statement: Beyond FAIL: the 3 public KO-contrast backgrounds ACTIVELY CONTRADICT the HAP1 machinery->presentation collapse (held-out HAP1 transfer rho = -0.92; public B2M-KO retains 88% of presentation vs HAP1's 3%). The H4 result does NOT generalize on the public KO-contrast data available.

carries_H4: HAP1 (PXD056426) — the only background where machinery-KO collapses presentation as H4 predicts
breaks_H4: THP-1 (ERAP1-KO 85%, but ERAP1 is a trimmer so weak-loss is expected — informative only as 'no collapse')
which_backgrounds_carry_vs_break.important_confound: A375/THP-1/HeLa contribute mostly ERAP1/TAPBPR (trimmer/editor) KOs, NOT the hard essentials (B2M/TAP1/TAP2/TAPBP) that drive the HAP1 collapse. The ONE hard-essential public replicate (A375 B2M-KO) is exactly the one that fails to collapse. So the corpus is under-powered on the discriminative KOs AND the single available replicate contradicts.

CRO_sizing_implication: FAIL/CONTRADICTED -> CRO MUST supply the missing cells. Cross-HLA generalization of H4 is NOT established (and is actively contradicted) on public KO-contrast data. The CRO must acquire >=3 distinct HLA backgrounds x the hard-essential machinery-KO panel (B2M, TAP1, TAP2, TAPBP at minimum) + same-flask matched proteome + absolute quant, with verified-complete KOs, before H4 can be trained/claimed cross-allele. The expensive path. Priority: resolve the A375 B2M-KO discordance first (leaky KO vs method vs genuine A*02-background B2M-independent presentation) because it, not statistical power, is the load-bearing failure.
caveats: Only 1 of 4 usable backgrounds (HAP1) has >=3 KO conditions -> only the HAP1 fold has a computable per-fold transfer Spearman; the other 3 folds are null by construction. The pooled statistic is effectively 'can A375+THP-1+HeLa predict HAP1' -> it strongly cannot (rho -0.92).

Presentation measure is WITHIN-DEPOSIT unique-peptide detection-count fraction of WT (batch-robust, HLA-agnostic); NEVER raw cross-lab intensity. Cross-checked against summed-spectral-count and intensity for A375 B2M-KO (0.88/0.86/0.65 — same story).
A375 is cross-method merged (PXD065279 MHC1-TIP DDA B2M-KO + PXD060572 DIA-NN ERAP1-KO); within-deposit normalization mitigates but does not erase method differences.

Matched proteome only available for HAP1 here -> B1 beyond-abundance metric computed for HAP1 only; the other 3 ran presentation-loss transfer only (labeled). ERAP1/TAPBPR being trimmer/editor KOs, their weak/inverted loss is biologically expected and is NOT evidence for or against H4's hard-essential claim.
Class-II (PXD020079 CIITA GBM) not runnable here (raw MS only); would gate separately once normalized.
Harness disjoint-allele check under-counts A*02 sharing (2-field vs 1-field token mismatch); corrected in this result. Verdict unaffected.
